dz: 教宗费利克斯三世将君士坦丁堡的保皇党人阿卡西乌斯驱逐出教区,支持赫诺蒂克翁,支持罢免保皇党人约翰·塔拉亚,导致阿卡西阿斯克主义.
de: Pope Felix III excommunicated patriarch Acacius of Constantinople for his support of the Henoticon and his support of the removal of patriarch John Talaia, leading to the Acacian schism.
